license_required.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice podiatric medicine without an active license or with a license fraudulently obtained.

issuing_authority.value: Board of Podiatric Medicine / Department of Health
issuing_authority.quote: The department shall examine each applicant who the board certifies

name.quote: "Board" means the Board of Podiatric Medicine as created in this chapter.

type.quote: "Board" means the Board of Podiatric Medicine as created in this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age.

degree_required.value: degree from a school or college of podiatric medicine or chiropody recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
degree_required.quote: Has received a degree from a school or college of podiatric medicine or chiropody recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

degree_level.quote: Has received a degree from a school or college of podiatric medicine or chiropody recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association. For applicants who matriculated prior to 1953, the course of study shall have been at least 3 years. For applicants who matriculated during or subsequent to 1953, the course of study shall be at least 4 years

school_approval_basis.quote: recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

credential_pegged.quote: Has received a degree from a school or college of podiatric medicine or chiropody recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association.

required.quote: Has satisfactorily completed one of the following clinical experience requirements: 1. One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board

experience_source.quote: Has satisfactorily completed one of the following clinical experience requirements: 1. One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board

duration.value: 1 year (or 10 years of continuous active licensed practice in another state)
duration.quote: One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board

kind.quote: One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board

exams.name: Licensure examination for podiatric physician
exams.notes: If applicant fails 3 attempts, must complete additional educational or training requirements; after 5 total failures, no longer eligible.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Health / Board of Podiatric Medicine)
exams.quote: Any person desiring to be licensed as a podiatric physician shall apply to the department to take the licensure examination.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: The board may by rule prescribe continuing education, not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license

hours_per_period.quote: not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license

period_years.quote: not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license

value: minimum 2 hours related to safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances
2-hour course on prevention of medical errors
2-hour course on prescribing controlled substances (DEA registrants)
domestic violence course (every third biennial renewal, chapters 458, 459, 464, 466, 467, 490, 491 only — Chapter 461 not listed but controlled substances applies)
topical_requirements.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

available.quote: An applicable board, or the department if there is no board, shall issue a license to practice in this state to an applicant who meets all of the following criteria

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement (MOBILE Act): active unencumbered license in another state with similar scope, national exam or certification recognized by board, 2 years active practice in 4 years preceding application, no disciplinary action in preceding 5 years, no pending disciplinary proceedings, meets financial responsibility requirements, background screening.
requirements.quote: Holds an active, unencumbered license issued by another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States in a profession with a similar scope of practice

exists.quote: "Board" means the Board of Podiatric Medicine as created in this chapter.

national_association.quote: recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

regulatory_model.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice podiatric medicine without an active license or with a license fraudulently obtained.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue a license to practice podiatric medicine to any applicant who successfully completes the examination in accordance with this section.

is_mandatory.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice podiatric medicine without an active license or with a license fraudulently obtained.

title_protection.quote: Using the name or title "Podiatrist," "Doctor of Podiatry," or "Doctor of Podiatric Medicine" or using the phrase "foot clinic," "foot doctor," "quiropedista," or any other name, title, or phrase which would lead the public to believe that such person is engaging in the practice of podiatric medicine unless such person is licensed as a podiatric physician in this state.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice podiatric medicine without an active license or with a license fraudulently obtained.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentations, or through board/department error.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license to practice podiatric medicine by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License to practice podiatric medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice podiatric medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted or found guilty of a crime in any jurisdiction directly relating to the practice of podiatric medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty, regardless of adjudication, of a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of podiatric medicine or to the ability to practice podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any person the licensee knows is in violation of the chapter or rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, permitting, or advising any unlicensed person to practice podiatric medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, permitting, or advising any unlicensed person to practice podiatric medicine contrary to this chapter or to rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed podiatric physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed podiatric physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report the licensee knows to be false, or failing to file a required report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another person to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of podiatric medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of podiatric medicine or employing a trick or scheme in the practice of podiatric medicine when such scheme or trick fails to conform to the generally prevailing standards of treatment in the podiatric community.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients either personally or through an agent, unless approved by board rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients either personally or through an agent, unless such solicitation falls into a category of solicitations approved by rule of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written medical records justifying the course of treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written medical records justifying the course of treatment of the patient, including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination results, and test results.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on the patient to exploit for financial gain of the licensee or a third party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on the patient or client in such a manner as to exploit the patient or client for financial gain of the licensee or of a third party

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services not duly authorized by the patient or legal representative.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client or her or his legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering a legend drug or controlled substance other than in the course of the podiatric physician's professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including all controlled substances, other than in the course of the podiatric physician's professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering a scheduled drug to oneself except when prescribed by another authorized practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893 by the podiatric physician to herself or himself except those prescribed, dispensed, or administered to the podiatric physician by another practitioner authorized to prescribe, dispense, or administer them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering amphetamines or sympathomimetic amine drugs designated as Schedule II controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving any amphetamine or sympathomimetic amine drug or compound designated as a Schedule II controlled substance pursuant to chapter 893.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated malpractice, or failure to practice at the recognized level of care and skill.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated malpractice or the failure to practice podiatric medicine at a level of care, skill, and treatment which is recognized by a reasonably prudent podiatric physician as being acceptable under similar conditions and circumstances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure or prescribing therapy constituting experimentation on human subjects without full informed written consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which, by the prevailing standards of podiatric medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law, or accepting responsibilities the licensee is not competent to perform.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know that she or he is not competent to perform.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the licensee delegating such responsibilities knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order of the board or department, or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board or department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring with another licensee to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another licensee from lawfully advertising services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with another licensee or with any other person to commit an act, or committing an act, which would tend to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another licensee from lawfully advertising her or his services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing growth hormones, testosterone, HCG, or other hormones for muscle building or athletic performance enhancement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving growth hormones, testosterone or its analogs, human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), or other hormones for the purpose of muscle building or to enhance athletic performance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of podiatric medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any licensee under chapter 458 or 459 known to have violated disciplinary grounds in a shared facility.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any licensee under chapter 458 or chapter 459 who the podiatric physician knows has violated the grounds for disciplinary action set out in the law under which that person is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with requirements to provide patients with information about their rights and how to file a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of ss. 381.026 and 381.0261 to provide patients with information about their patient rights and how to file a patient complaint.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

insurance_required.quote: the Board of Podiatric Medicine shall, by rule, require that all health care practitioners licensed under the respective board … maintain medical malpractice insurance or provide proof of financial responsibility

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg. The surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg shall be limited anatomically to that part below the anterior tibial tubercle. The practice of podiatric medicine shall include the amputation of the toes or other parts of the foot but shall not include the amputation of the foot or leg in its entirety.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg. The surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg shall be limited anatomically to that part below the anterior tibial tubercle. The practice of podiatric medicine shall include the amputation of the toes or other parts of the foot but shall not include the amputation of the foot or leg in its entirety.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg

drug_authority.value: A podiatric physician may prescribe drugs that relate specifically to the scope of practice authorized herein.
drug_authority.quote: A podiatric physician may prescribe drugs that relate specifically to the scope of practice authorized herein.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg shall be limited anatomically to that part below the anterior tibial tubercle.

amputation_authorized.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine shall include the amputation of the toes or other parts of the foot but shall not include the amputation of the foot or leg in its entirety.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A podiatric physician who is supervising a medical assistant shall be governed by s. 458.3485.

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: a licensed podiatric physician may authorize or direct a certified podiatric X-ray assistant to operate such equipment and expose such films under the licensed podiatric physician's direction and supervision, pursuant to rules adopted by the board … which ensures that such certified podiatric X-ray assistant is competent to operate such equipment in a safe and efficient manner by reason of training, experience, and passage of a board-approved course which includes an examination.

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: the Board of Podiatric Medicine shall, by rule, require that all health care practitioners licensed under the respective board … maintain medical malpractice insurance or provide proof of financial responsibility

telehealth_authorized.quote: "Telehealth provider" means any individual who provides health care and related services using telehealth and who is licensed or certified under … chapter 461

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This chapter shall not prohibit the manufacture, advertisement, or sale of proprietary corrective shoes, foot appliances, or remedies.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: a person who the licensee knows is unable to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition, may be reported to a consultant operating an impaired practitioner program as described in s. 456.076 rather than to the department.

electronic_prescribing_required.quote: A health care practitioner licensed by law to prescribe a medicinal drug who maintains a system of electronic health records … may only electronically transmit prescriptions for such drugs.

nondiscrimination_in_public_programs.quote: A chiropractic physician licensed under chapter 460 or a podiatric physician licensed under chapter 461 shall not be denied payment for treatment rendered solely on the basis that the chiropractic physician or podiatric physician is not a member of a particular preferred provider organization or exclusive provider organization
